propositions: The single-pass demo engine, parity harness, prompt, and eval-solver branch must be removed while preserving the four-phase workflows unchanged and the catalog's single default reviewer.
Finished-cutover scaffolding including shadow comparators, spot-eval harness, and private re-exports prohibited by ADR 0111 must be deleted with importers migrated.
Severity-driven gate policy, REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH config, and legacy overlay activate: list form must be retired or deprecated with appropriate warnings.
Five confirmed-dead attestation helpers must be removed, duplicated unresolvable-ref messages consolidated, and plan-review status surface limited to schema-declared values.
All client-facing changes must include release-notes entries.
